name: Devil Domain — Chapter 1: The Stolen Light
audio: Original synthesized cinematic music and effects only — no speech and no dialogue captions
character_design: Original simple rounded characters with triangular horns, small feet; villain with a short temporary action claw

scenes.action: Three horned guardians protect a turquoise crystal on a stone pedestal. Film lighting and an ominous score introduce the story.
The dangerous devil emerges from the dark. He dwarfs the innocent heroes; a low bass impact signals danger.
The devil approaches the pedestal first, then uses a short jointed claw to physically pick up the diamond and hold it at his side. The diamond never spins above his head.

He runs across the rocky foreground and enters the dark cave built into the base of the mountain. His position is clamped to the cave entrance; he disappears inside instead of running beyond the mountain.
Emerald, Ocean, and Slate pack small backpacks and open an old paper map.
They walk on short alternating feet toward a huge forbidding mountain, keeping the map in hand.
DEVIL DOMAIN — CHAPTER I: THE STOLEN LIGHT. THE JOURNEY BEGINS.
